scope: Reference-specific map for the selected AthenaK Q011 p0=1 shock baseline against Bai et al. (2015) and Sun and Bai Section 5.4 only. Exact textual setup values are mapped; approximate plotted or descriptive outcomes are not converted into numeric acceptance tolerances.
matched_equations: Bai et al. Section 5 Equation (34) gives the strong-shock downstream-frame jump-condition normalization and v_sh=v0/(r-1), with r=4 for gamma=5/3.
Sun and Bai Section 5.4 uses the ideal shock surface x=u_sh_prime*t with u_sh_prime=(Gamma-1)u0/2, equal to u0/3 for Gamma=5/3.
Sun and Bai Section 5.4 defines c/omega_pi=(q/(m*c))^-1/sqrt(rho0)=U_A0/Omega0 and Omega0=B0*q/(m*c).
Sun and Bai Section 2.2 Equations (3)-(6) provide the no-Hall ideal-MHD-PIC carrier and CR feedback equations used by the AthenaK Q011 baseline.

provenance_entries.section: 5. Particle acceleration in collisionless shocks: simulation setup
provenance_entries.reference_statement: For a strong downstream-frame shock, rho1=r*rho0, P1=r*rho0*v0^2/(r-1), Bx1=Bx0, and v_sh=v0/(r-1), with r=4 for gamma=5/3.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The Q011 ideal-surface speed is 10 U_A0 for u0=30 U_A0 and gamma=5/3.

provenance_entries.section: 5. Particle acceleration in collisionless shocks: simulation setup
provenance_entries.reference_statement: rho0=B0=q/(m*c)=1, T0=P0=1, v0=30, and the thermal choice is stated to be irrelevant while T0 is much smaller than v0^2.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The selected Q011 baseline uses ps_rho0=1, ps_b0=1, species mass=charge=1, ps_p0=1, and ps_u0=30.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The listed high-Mach parallel-shock runs use M_A=30, domains 1.2e5 by 3000 c/omega_pi, standard resolution 12 c/omega_pi per cell, eta values 1e-3 to 4e-3, and C=1e4 for non-relativistic runs.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q011 selects eta=1e-3, C=1e4, and a smaller Sun-and-Bai Section 5.4 domain; it is not an exact Bai et al. domain reproduction.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: A uniform super-Alfvenic flow strikes a reflecting left wall; B0 and the flow are parallel; particles are injected evenly and continuously at the ideal shock surface.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q011 uses reflecting/inflow x1 boundaries, periodic x2, parallel B0 and flow, and ideal-surface injection.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: Injected protons are monoenergetic and isotropic relative to the ideal shock surface with p/m=sqrt(10)*u0; their injected mass is eta times swept mass and their mass, momentum, and energy are subtracted from the gas.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q011 uses ps_vinj_over_u0=sqrt(10), ps_eta=1e-3, ideal-surface injection, and gas subtraction.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The box is 48000 by 3120 c/omega_pi; M_A=30, Gamma=5/3, eta=1e-3, and C=1e4 U_A0; particles injected before 45 Omega0^-1 are removed.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The Q011 production-science deck exactly carries these stated values.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The fiducial AMR run has three total levels with cell sizes 12, 6, and 3 c/omega_pi, 20 by 20-cell MeshBlocks, curvature refine threshold 1.0, derefine threshold 0.1, and approximately 40 downstream ppc at the finest level and 640 at the coarsest.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The Q011 deck and macro-mass derivation carry the same stated AMR ladder, MeshBlock size, thresholds, and downstream particle-count targets.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The downstream spectra are shown at 500 and 1200 Omega0^-1 and the later spectrum is described as approaching f(epsilon) proportional to epsilon^-3/2.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q011 retains snapshots at these nominal times and a downstream-spectrum reducer, but no numeric agreement tolerance is supplied by this map.

intentional_mismatches: Sun and Bai Section 5.4 does not explicitly state upstream P0; Q011 p0=1 is selected from the cited Bai et al. setup and must not be described as an explicit Sun-and-Bai parameter.
Sun and Bai injects at an ideal shock surface; Bai et al. dynamically identifies the shock and uses a more involved injection and compensation treatment.
Q011 eta=1e-3 matches Sun and Bai and Bai run R1, but it does not match Bai's fiducial R2 eta=2e-3.
Q011 uses the Sun-and-Bai 48000 by 3120 c/omega_pi domain rather than Bai et al.'s 1.2e5 by 3000 c/omega_pi standard domain.
Q011 is no-Hall, matching the Sun-and-Bai carrier scope but not reproducing Bai et al.'s CR-Hall-modified formulation.
AthenaK solver, reconstruction, AMR implementation, load balancing, random realization, and output reducers are not claimed identical to Athena or Athena++.
excluded_regimes: relativistic shocks or the Bai reduced-C trans-relativistic run
Bai et al. dynamically tracked shock injection as an exact match
exact numerical-algorithm identity across Athena, Athena++, and AthenaK
numeric agreement claims based on approximate text or undigitized figures
using the existing Q011 engineering acceptance range as a Q022 reference-derived tolerance
tolerance_policy: No numeric shock comparison tolerance is supplied by this successor. Approximate textual descriptions and undigitized Figures 8-9 are retained as qualitative context only. Freeze extracted-data provenance and tolerances before inspecting qualifying AthenaK comparison output.
blocked_inputs: Sun and Bai Section 5.4 does not explicitly state P0; the selected p0=1 baseline is bound to Bai et al. and must remain labeled as such.
No authorized figure extraction with uncertainty exists for Figures 8-9 or Bai et al. shock figures.
No reference-derived numeric comparison tolerance has been frozen.
Exact cross-code numerical-algorithm equivalence is not established.
External scientific reviewer disposition remains pending.
